adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the mutation explicitly allows a non-organizer attendee to add guests (`const isAttendee = ...` and permission check). But the calendar update is executed via `new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...credentials] })` where `user`/`credentials` come from `ctx.user` (the caller), not the booking organizer. The booking query even includes `booking.user.credentials`, but those aren’t used. If the caller is an attendee (not the organizer), their credentials likely can’t update the organizer’s destination calendar, so `updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` can fail/no-op for valid callers.
